decision: Add a bounded read-only directory listing and a lazy right-side tree panel: FileEntry/FileListResponse in shared/protocol, listDirectory in src/serve/files (hidden/ignored split, dirs-first sort, limit+truncated), GET /api/files, api.listFiles, and a FileTree panel with expand/cache, hidden/ignored toggles, refresh, loading and retry
why: a later milestone writes files and the UI needs a listing to hang them on, and the response shape is a fixed contract later units must not re-derive
evidence: test/serve/files.test.ts (dirs-first + held-back dotfiles/ignored, real size and numeric mtime, showHidden/showIgnored, symlink kind, limit+truncated, escape/NotADirectory), test/serve/files-http.test.ts (root, ?path=src, 400 escape with no listing leak, 404, ?showHidden=1)
result: 1088 tests (3 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude spawn-timeout tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit e42e3a5

decision: Stream one workspace file to the browser: statPath in src/serve/files classifies missing/directory/file, GET /api/files/download streams via createReadStream with attachment/octet-stream/length headers, api.fileDownloadUrl builds the token-aware link, and each non-directory FileTree row gets a 下载 anchor
why: the owner must pull artifacts the agent wrote out of the workspace, and streaming a real HTTP response (never a buffered body) keeps a large file off the server and browser heaps
evidence: test/serve/files-http.test.ts (byte-for-byte 200 with Content-Disposition basename and Content-Length, 400 escape as JSON not bytes, 404 missing, 400 directory message), test/web/api.test.ts (fileDownloadUrl percent-encodes the path and appends the token)
result: 1090/1092 tests (2 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude spawn-timeout tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit 3f1527f

decision: Multipart streaming upload: register @fastify/multipart (fileSize 100 MiB, files 20, fields 10, preservePath so a traversal is seen), POST /api/files/upload with a route bodyLimit above the cap and the global 1 MiB limit, per-file basename validation, a temp-sibling stream + rename with a byte counter, the exists/overwrite policy, api.upload over XMLHttpRequest with progress, and a FileTree drop target with a per-file progress list and an overwrite retry
why: the owner must land artifacts into a chosen workspace directory with progress and an overwrite policy, and streaming each part to disk keeps a large file off the server and browser heaps
evidence: test/serve/files-http.test.ts (small file byte-for-byte with the written relative path, a >1 MiB body, exists then overwrite asserting the new bytes, ../evil.txt refused on the name with no escape, path=../../etc 400, over-cap 413, mixed ok:false with written+failed), test/web/api.test.ts (FormData path/overwrite/token and progress, ok:false resolves, 413 rejects with the server reason)
result: 1101 tests (2 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit 5d88c2d
